reviews.status: Geometry observations accepted on earlier teal-contact set; final finish acceptance pending warm-stone revision
findings: Straight and modestly curved coping form a continuous tile/slat edge; slots remain legible at640 and actual drain throat is open in underside detail.

Light teal tile surfaces, ivory drain slats and narrow alloy rails fit the aquatic family without introducing a water shader or bright effects. The warm orange emphasis is supplied by companion lounge/float components.

Entry has four readable level changes, a central unbarred route, returned paired rails, surface flanges and fitted side/stringer supports. The normal correction removed the initial crossed-cap defect.
Inspection stand blocks and gray upper/lower platforms are QA fixtures. The views are neither an installed pool nor evidence of handrail strength, wet grip, safety code or accessible circulation.

reviews.status: PASS final warm-stone finish and corrected stringer knees
findings: Warm-stone bullnose and tread surfaces now provide the pale warm contact hierarchy. Teal remains on rear aprons/thin cheeks; dark flush grip strips remain legible.
Final entry views have no protruding stringer knees on riser fronts. Clear central route, returned rails, shaped nosings and mounting flanges are retained.
Earlier underside images remain shape-specific supporting evidence with their original hashes and materials; they are not mislabelled as final finish captures.
The warm lounger/table, pale coping/entry, restrained teal trim and orange/pearl float form a coherent small family.
Overview shows explicit component relationships and two levels; full lower standing view retains all components at an ordinary1.65m height above the lower display.
Dry-entry640 is deliberately a cropped route view, with the lounger cut at left. It does not serve as a full-component silhouette gate.

Neutral supports are visibly inspection fixtures, including the float resting on a lower display. No water surface, dense landscaping, inhabited resort, game room or physical behavior is depicted or claimed.
The reference response is at shape/material/component-use scale. These grey QA platforms are not evidence that the full atmospheric resort reference has been built.
